### 4. Scored parameters (words, inputs, tiers, values)

**(a) Claim fitting charge (claim d5a9a3ac, left_rear).** Baseline (`claim_fitting_charge_calculation`): "the package's package price per tire, for the one tire fitted" = 31.99 (`installation_package_price_schedule`, With Road Hazard row). Factors, each found from record words and applied multiplicatively on the unrounded amount, rounded once:
- Card tender (`claim_fitting_card_tender_rates`): purchase tender `northgate_visa` → 0.9.
- Mileage usage (`claim_fitting_mileage_usage_scale`): (60850−21406)/70000 = 39444/70000 = 0.563486 < 0.6 → × share.
- Plus member rate (`claim_fitting_plus_member_rates`): Plus tier; tenure 2011-04-09 → 2026-01-24 = 177 whole months ≥ 120 → 0.5.
- Replacement history (`claim_fitting_replacement_history_rates`): RH replacement entries (2) + treadwear claim entries (1) = 3 → 0.8.
- 31.99 × 0.9 × 0.563486 × 0.5 × 0.8 = 6.48933 → **$6.49**; service_date 2026-01-24, odometer 60850, source d5a9a3ac.

**(b) Treadwear credit (claim d5a9a3ac, left_rear), booked today 2026-10-05.** Baseline (`treadwear_credit_proration`): price paid per tire × remaining mileage share. Price paid = 179.99 − 20.00 = 159.99.
- Price by claim age (`treadwear_credit_price_per_tire_by_claim_age`): 2023-11-18 → 2026-01-24 = 26 months < 36 → higher of 159.99 and replacement tire charge against the claim 169.99 → 169.99.
- Mileage extension (`treadwear_mileage_extension_for_members`): Plus tier → 1.1; extended 77000; share (77000−39444)/77000 = 0.487740.
- Tread factor (`treadwear_credit_tread_depth_reduction`): tread 1/32 → 0.9.
- Rotation uplift (`treadwear_rotation_care_uplift`): 5 rotation entries → 39444/6 = 6574 → 1.05.
- Late-settlement allowance (`treadwear_late_settlement_allowance`): 2026-01-24 → 2026-10-05 = 254 days > 180 → +$10.00.
- Membership-years allowance (`treadwear_membership_years_allowance`): 16 fee charges ≥ 15 → +$12.00.
- 169.99 × 0.487740 × 0.9 × 1.05 + 10 + 12 = 100.35086 → **$100.35**.

**(c) Road hazard credit (RH entry 1da17a80, left_rear) — the scored root.** Baseline (`road_hazard_credit_calculation`): road hazard price paid per tire × credit share.
- Price by wheel replacement history (`road_hazard_credit_price_for_refitted_wheels`): a treadwear claim entry is recorded for left_rear → replacement tire charge against that claim (169.99) less the treadwear credit booked against it (100.35, after (b)) = 69.64.
- Wear: (10−7)/(10−2) = 37.5 % > full-credit limit 25 % → share by proration.
- Worn-tire proration (`road_hazard_worn_tire_proration`): warranty miles 70000 > 0; mounting point = treadwear claim 2026-01-24 @ 60850; months on wheel to 2026-10-03 = 8 < 12 → greater of usable tread share (7−2)/8 = 0.625 and warranty miles share (70000−15030)/70000 = 0.785286 → 0.785286.
- Plus uplift (`road_hazard_plus_member_uplift`): Plus tier + Northgate Visa → 1.1.
- Repeat replacement share (`road_hazard_repeat_replacement_share`): 2 RH entries on package (current included) → 0.9.
- Term remaining share (`road_hazard_term_remaining_share`): 36 − whole months 2023-11-18 → 2026-10-03 (34) = 2 < 3 → 0.85.
- 69.64 × 0.785286 × 1.1 × 0.9 × 0.85 = 46.01936 → **$46.02**.

### Two-way counter-proof

- Closest alternatives excluded: (i) price = road hazard price paid per tire (159.99) — excluded by the refitted-wheel table's first tier ("a treadwear claim entry is recorded for that wheel position"); (ii) usable-tread share 0.625 — excluded by the worn-tire proration (months on the wheel 8 < 12 → greater share); (iii) mounting at installation (21406) — excluded by the "Mounting point" definition (latest treadwear claim on that wheel); (iv) extended warranty miles in the RH warranty share — the extension doc is scoped "For a Northgate Tire Center treadwear credit"; (v) crediting the earlier right_front RH entry — documents fix "the most recent road hazard replacement entry"; (vi) claim-fitting replacement-history count excluding later RH entries — "entries dated after the claim entry are included".
- "Do only the one thing asked" excluded: posting only the RH credit now would require a price "less the treadwear credit booked against that same claim entry" when none is booked, and the RH price table says the credit "is not fixed while that claim's treadwear credit does not yet stand on the package"; posting the treadwear credit without the fitting charge contradicts "not booked until the wheel … carries its claim fitting charge". Both blocks rest on prerequisite sentences on the blocked side, not on pre-solved statements.
- Fall-back answer (computation documents only): RH credit = 159.99 × 0.625 (wear above 25 %) = 99.99375 → $99.99 ≠ $46.02. Claim fitting fall-back $31.99 ≠ $6.49; treadwear fall-back 159.99 × 30556/70000 = $69.84 ≠ $100.35. All definite (product figures named: package price per tire, new/coverage-end tread, full-credit limit — all in tire docs).
- Factor findability (record words → document): `tender: northgate_visa` on the purchase → "Card Tender Rates …" / "Plus Membership and Northgate Visa Uplift …"; `Northgate Club Plus Membership` + fee schedule Plus premium 65.00 → Plus documents; `tire_treadwear_adjusted` on left_rear → "Road Hazard Credit Price by Wheel Replacement History", worn-tire "Mounting point"; two `tire_road_hazard_replaced` entries → "Repeat Replacement Share", "Replacement History Rate Table"; `tire_rotation_performed` ×5 → "Rotation Uplift on Treadwear Credits"; `membership_fee_charged` ×16 → "Membership-Years Allowance"; claim date vs today → "Late-Settlement Allowance"; install date vs replacement date → "Term Schedule — Share by Months Remaining". Every factor document is retrieved by KB_search on the charge's own name (e.g. "claim fitting charge treadwear claim" returns all five claim-fitting documents). No computation document hinted at a variation.
